title: Profile (static-archive): reject stream session-control transcript
description: A serialized SAR stream transcript (valid in stream-session context) must be rejected by the static-archive profile. The static-archive profile requires indexed, forward-access archives and does not support SESSION_CONTROL content or NO_INDEX streams. The binary file is shared with valid/stream-session/session-init/.
notes: The binary file is shared with valid/stream-session/session-init/.
In stream-session conformance mode, the bytes are valid (SAR_OK).

The same serialized SAR stream transcript bytes are valid in stream-transcript context but rejected by default sar-archive parsing because SESSION_CONTROL / nonzero OP_CODE is not accepted in safe archive mode.
The static-archive profile manifest documents the intended profile-rejection context. Full profile-conformance execution remains separate future profile work.
In static-archive profile mode, the bytes must be rejected: the static-archive profile does not accept NO_INDEX archives or SESSION_CONTROL content.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
